lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the gill region along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity that align with the vertical positioning of the circular blobs, forming a discernible coordinate-like lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features extending along the upper and mid-flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient with light highlights on the upper edge and shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots scattered across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to and swimming near the ventral-lateral flank of the primary subject.
